highlights: CJEU C-399/24 (16.10.2025): lightning strike + mandatory inspection may be an extraordinary circumstance under Art. 5(3) VO 261/2004 if airline proves all reasonable measures.
General Court T-656/24 (04.03.2026): an airline's autonomous decision in a rotation can break the causal link to an earlier-flight extraordinary circumstance, preserving the compensation claim.

Council & Parliament provisional agreement (15.06.2026): first EU air passenger-rights overhaul since 2004 — 96h/30-day claim rules, burden of proof on airline, no-show ban, hand baggage included; amounts stay EUR 250/400/600. Not yet in force.
actions_taken: opened PR (human review only; no merge)
